abstract: Testicular tumor of the cryptorchid testis associated with renal dysplasia is relatively infrequent and indicates maldevelopment during embryogenesis. We report a case of a 31-year-old man with a mixed germ cell tumor found in an intra-abdominal testis associated with an ipsilateral ectopic dysplastic kidney. He underwent orchiectomy with partial cystectomy. Simple nephrectomy was also performed. No evidence of disease recurrence was found at 16 months of follow-up.
abstract_ja: 停留精巣に合併する精巣腫瘍と腎形成異常は比較的まれであり、胚発生中の形成異常を示す。我々は、腹腔内精巣に混合型胚細胞腫瘍を認め、同側に異所性形成異常腎を合併した31歳男性の症例を報告する。患者は精巣摘除術と部分的嚢胞切除を受け、単純腎摘除術も施行された。フォローアップ16か月の時点で再発の所見は認められなかった。
